subject.title: feat(providers): add Meta Model API - muse-spark-1.1

question: Should Meta Model API be accepted as a bundled OpenClaw provider, or should this work be redirected to an external ClawHub/npm provider package?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible and has live proof, but the repository vision and current SDK already support external provider plugins, while bundled inclusion adds dependency, auth, config, and docs surfaces that require maintainer ownership.

options.title: Publish externally
options.body: Close or redirect this PR to a ClawHub/npm provider package that uses the current provider SDK and manifest auth metadata without adding core wiring.

options.title: Sponsor bundled inclusion
options.body: Keep the PR open only if a maintainer explicitly owns Meta as a bundled provider and resolves the dependency, auth, docs, and upgrade risks before merge.

recommendation.title: Publish externally
recommendation.body: Close or redirect this PR to a ClawHub/npm provider package that uses the current provider SDK and manifest auth metadata without adding core wiring.

likelyOwner.reason: @jalehman is the current assignee after the reopen, so he is the best visible owner to confirm whether this PR should continue in core review.
